unknown.title: Workspace request unavailable
unknown.explanation: The request could not be completed through the local API boundary.
unknown.recovery: Verify the local services and retry the request.

api_unavailable.title: Local API unavailable
api_unavailable.explanation: The workspace could not reach the local API through the same-origin gateway.
api_unavailable.recovery: Verify FastAPI is running on loopback, then retry.

api_request_failed.title: API request failed
api_request_failed.explanation: The local API rejected or could not complete this request.
api_request_failed.recovery: Review the safe backend detail and retry only when appropriate.

api_response_invalid.title: API response is invalid
api_response_invalid.explanation: The response did not match the generated frontend contract.
api_response_invalid.recovery: Verify the Web and API versions match before retrying.

not_found.title: Strategy not found
not_found.explanation: The requested strategy identifier is not present in the backend catalog.
not_found.recovery: Return to the strategy list and choose an available definition.

research_artifact_root_unavailable.title: Research artifact root unavailable
research_artifact_root_unavailable.explanation: The configured research artifact root could not be inspected.
research_artifact_root_unavailable.recovery: Verify the configured research storage and retry without deleting data.

research_artifact_invalid.title: Research artifacts are invalid
research_artifact_invalid.explanation: Configured research evidence failed backend validation.
research_artifact_invalid.recovery: Inspect the operator configuration and source artifacts before retrying.

research_run_not_found.title: Research run not found
research_run_not_found.explanation: The exact experiment slug and run ID were not found.
research_run_not_found.recovery: Return to research runs and choose an available record.

evidence_artifact_root_unavailable.title: Evidence root unavailable
evidence_artifact_root_unavailable.explanation: The configured evidence artifact root could not be inspected.
evidence_artifact_root_unavailable.recovery: Verify the configured evidence storage and retry without deleting data.

evidence_artifact_invalid.title: Evidence artifacts are invalid
evidence_artifact_invalid.explanation: Configured governance or report evidence failed backend validation.
evidence_artifact_invalid.recovery: Inspect the operator configuration and source artifacts before retrying.

evidence_manifest_not_found.title: Evidence manifest not found
evidence_manifest_not_found.explanation: The exact manifest type and artifact key were not found.
evidence_manifest_not_found.recovery: Return to evidence manifests and choose an available record.

product_database_unavailable.title: Product database unavailable
product_database_unavailable.explanation: Durable local product state cannot currently be read.
product_database_unavailable.recovery: Verify the configured product database and migrations, then retry.

paper_artifact_root_unavailable.title: Paper artifact root unavailable
paper_artifact_root_unavailable.explanation: Authoritative completed paper artifacts cannot currently be read.
paper_artifact_root_unavailable.recovery: Verify the configured paper artifact storage and retry without deleting outputs.

paper_job_not_found.title: Paper job not found
paper_job_not_found.explanation: The requested durable paper job ID was not found.
paper_job_not_found.recovery: Return to Paper Jobs and choose an available job.

paper_job_invalid.title: Paper job request is invalid
paper_job_invalid.explanation: The submitted command did not satisfy the backend paper-job contract.
paper_job_invalid.recovery: Review the entered transport values and submit again only after correction.

paper_job_idempotency_conflict.title: Idempotency key conflicts with another request
paper_job_idempotency_conflict.explanation: The same idempotency key is already bound to different request content.
paper_job_idempotency_conflict.recovery: Use the original exact request for replay or choose a new intentional key.

paper_job_conflict.title: Paper job conflicts with an existing job
paper_job_conflict.explanation: The requested durable identity conflicts with existing product state.
paper_job_conflict.recovery: Inspect the existing job before deciding whether to submit a distinct request.

paper_job_state_conflict.title: Paper job state changed
paper_job_state_conflict.explanation: Another action or execution changed the job before this command completed.
paper_job_state_conflict.recovery: Refresh status manually before deciding what to do next.

paper_job_output_conflict.title: Existing paper output conflicts with this operation
paper_job_output_conflict.explanation: Authoritative output already exists or conflicts with the requested operation.
paper_job_output_conflict.recovery: Inspect the job and outputs; do not overwrite or delete them automatically.

paper_job_recovery_failed.title: Paper job recovery inspection failed
paper_job_recovery_failed.explanation: The backend could not complete the explicit interrupted-job inspection.
paper_job_recovery_failed.recovery: Review the stale threshold and current job state before retrying recovery.

paper_job_result_unavailable.title: Paper job result unavailable
paper_job_result_unavailable.explanation: The backend does not currently expose an authoritative result for this job.
paper_job_result_unavailable.recovery: Inspect the paper job status and result-availability flag.

paper_job_result_invalid.title: Paper job result is invalid
paper_job_result_invalid.explanation: The backend rejected the completed result during authoritative validation.
paper_job_result_invalid.recovery: Inspect the job and operator guidance; do not recalculate or repair it in the browser.

lifecycle_transition_proposal_invalid.title: Lifecycle proposal is invalid
lifecycle_transition_proposal_invalid.explanation: The proposal did not satisfy backend lifecycle and evidence rules.
lifecycle_transition_proposal_invalid.recovery: Review the source snapshot, requested transition, and evidence before resubmitting.

lifecycle_transition_record_invalid.title: Human review record is invalid
lifecycle_transition_record_invalid.explanation: The review record did not satisfy backend human-control rules.
lifecycle_transition_record_invalid.recovery: Review the explicit outcome and resulting-snapshot requirements before resubmitting.

request_validation_error.title: Command structure is invalid
request_validation_error.explanation: The submitted request does not match the generated API contract.
request_validation_error.recovery: Correct the marked fields and retry without changing backend authority.

demo_workspace_not_configured.title: Demo workspace not configured
demo_workspace_not_configured.explanation: This local origin is running the valid unseeded Standard Workspace.
demo_workspace_not_configured.recovery: Use the documented isolated Demo startup only when demonstration data is desired.

demo_workspace_unavailable.title: Demo workspace unavailable
demo_workspace_unavailable.explanation: The Demo descriptor could not be read from the configured isolated workspace.
demo_workspace_unavailable.recovery: Verify the isolated Demo startup and retry workspace discovery.
